scope: Sources in the preserved winning pipeline versus later experiments. Presence does not prove an independent positive effect.

sources.name: Hourly historical boarding aggregates
sources.effect: Target history and statistical route-hour profiles; raw individual transactions excluded from the image.

sources.name: Weekdays, holidays, school/summer regimes
sources.effect: Features used; education dates include generic proxies. No isolated causal-effect claim.

sources.name: Historical weather / reanalysis
sources.effect: Weather enters v4 CatBoost component used by v5_experts. Retrospective values, not archived two-month-ahead forecasts. No winner-specific weather ablation.

sources.name: Tram service changes, cancellations and repairs
sources.effect: Explicit regime experts and cancellation adjustment; source-specific causal effect not isolated.

sources.name: Reported UAV and connectivity events
sources.effect: Report-derived features in v4; not measured street-level connectivity.

sources.name: GTFS schedule snapshot
sources.coverage: Static snapshot expanded over 2025; 9 of 10 routes
sources.effect: Schedule features in v4; not actual dispatched vehicles or a verified timetable for every future date.

sources.name: Stops, route geometry and nearby objects
sources.effect: Reference geometry in the dashboard and route-transfer features in v4. No learned stop-level demand model.

sources.name: External monthly transport seasonality
sources.effect: Used in upstream normalized profiles; not an observed hidden route-level target.

sources.name: Reported car crashes near tram stops
sources.effect: Later experiments only; not in the chosen 0.89402 model. This is not congestion or traffic speed.

sources.name: Historical Moscow road congestion / speeds
sources.effect: Not obtained. No traffic-input or traffic-effect claim for this service.
